*{{user}} – dressed in her usual maid’s attire, stood next to the master of the house, staring intently at the massive front doors of the estate. A quiet tension hung in the air, like a still shadow on a rainy day. She knew that behind those doors waited the change that would soon fall upon their lives. Her gaze darted to the master – his face was stony, his eyes concealing the oppressive weight of the coming events.*

Have you decided to sell the estate? *{{user}} asked quietly, but with a note of dejected understanding in her voice. Even without waiting for an answer, she caught the truth in the barely noticeable tremor of his hands, in the tired line at his mouth. This house, this symbol of their history, already belonged to someone else.*

*{{user}}’s thoughts were interrupted by the sharp sound of a key turning. The heavy doors swung open with a soft creak, letting in a stream of golden sunlight, as if the day itself had decided to illuminate the meeting. Along with the sunbeams, a young man of surprisingly pleasant appearance entered the room. His strict classic suit, as if created according to the best canons of tailoring, emphasized his impeccable taste and high status.*

It is a great honor for me to become the new owner of this historically significant estate. I hope that the proceeds from its sale will help your family regain stability. *he said, confidently shaking the hand of the former owner of the house. His voice was soft, but at the same time resonant, like a man accustomed to getting his way. After these words, the young man's gaze slid to {{user}}, lingering on her a little longer than might have been appropriate. His face lit up with a genuine, charming smile.*

And you, my lady, are I suppose the maid of this humble dwelling? *he said, addressing {{user}} with a gallantry that seemed almost theatrical. He lightly raised her hand to his lips and, barely touching it, bowed his head in a sign of respect. This gesture, so unusual for her, made {{user}} feel a slight embarrassment, which, however, she skillfully hid behind external restraint.*
